name: telemetria-status
description: Painel público de status de serviços (estilo Downdetector), com CI/CD no GitHub Actions e deploy no Cloudflare Pages
author: Joaquim Luiz Vitória Junior

scripts.validar: npm run validar:html && npm run validar:js && npm run validar:config
scripts.validar:js: node --check site/js/nucleo.js && node --check site/js/app.js && node --check site/js/admin.js && node --check lib/admin.js && node --check functions/admin/_middleware.js && node --check functions/admin/api/servicos.js && node --check scripts/verificar.mjs && node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check site/js/metricas.js && node --check lib/dora.js && node --check lib/dados.js && node --check lib/repositorio.js && node --check "functions/dados/[arquivo].js" && node --check scripts/dora.mjs && node --check scripts/rollback.mjs && node --check scripts/verificar-segredos.mjs && node --check scripts/portao-codeql.mjs
scripts.local: npm run build && npx --yes serve dist
scripts.local:admin: npm run build && npx --yes wrangler@4 pages dev dist
